messages.content: Return one JSON object only, with no code fences, with "primary_topic", "topics" and "tracking_numbers". Topics: status_question, delay, return, damage, address_change, claim_followup, billing, other. Return tracking numbers as a plain list of strings exactly as written in the message.

Hello,

I paid for Express delivery for my laptop charger from Delta Gadgets and it came today instead of yesterday. I needed it on Monday, that is why I paid more. I want my delivery fee back.

I can't find the tracking number, the shop's message went to my old phone. It was sent from Cairo to me in Alexandria.

Thank you,
Mona Gaber
